subject: Reservation: cluster floor, surge options & rollforward - QuantifyAI
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@quantify.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-24T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Cluster reservation conversation — initial options

Hi Oliver,

Great speaking earlier. Per our call, I've sketched three reservation approaches you can evaluate based on peak throughput needs and predictable unit cost. High-level:

- Option A — Baseline floor: 8 GPUs, monthly commit. Fast activation, lowest monthly commitment, modest discount.
- Option B — Growth ladder: start 8 GPUs, step to 16 at month 3, step to 32 at month 6. Better blended unit price.
- Option C — Surge-enabled: 8 GPUs baseline + 16 GPU burst pool (shared, on demand) with pre-warmed slots for <100ms cold start.

I've attached a spreadsheet that breaks down token-based unit economics, expected latency for 1k concurrent requests, and suggested rollout cadence.

Attachment: qai-reservation-options.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Can you confirm target steady-state throughput and any hard constraints (SLA/region/air-gapped)? I'll iterate with Ops on ramp timing.

Thanks,

Naomi Feldman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com
(415) 555-0124

From: Oliver Grant <oliver@quantify.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-25T10:34:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Cluster reservation conversation — initial options

Hi Naomi,

Thanks — the options look promising. A few clarifying Qs before we share with Procurement:

1) Minimum guaranteed GPUs for Option B during month-2 buffer (we need to guarantee 12k tokens/s)
2) Ramp schedule: can you do month-based triggers tied to usage thresholds rather than hard dates?
3) Any SLA exceptions for onboarding spikes (we expect a marketing-driven launch in M4)

Cc'd Procurement (procurement@quantify.ai) — they'll need the precise cancellation terms and any credit/refund policy.

Oliver Grant
VP Engineering, QuantifyAI
oliver@quantify.ai

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@quantify.ai>, procurement@quantify.ai
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-26T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Cluster reservation conversation — initial options

Oliver,

Answers inline:

1) Option B minimum during the month-2 buffer can be set to 12 GPUs (we can map 12 GPUs ≈ 12k tokens/s for your model family). That would be the 'guaranteed floor' during the buffer window.
2) We can make ramp triggers usage-threshold-based (e.g., 85% average utilization over a rolling 7-day window) instead of fixed-date upgrades. We'll include a 14-day notification/validation window.
3) Onboarding SLA exceptions: we can carve out a one-time "onboarding burst" that allows an extra 8 GPUs for up to 72 hours with no additional commit (for a launch). This requires approval from Sales Ops.

I've updated the spreadsheet with the 12 GPU floor for month-2 and a sample threshold rule. Also attached a short SLA-exception request form.

Attachments: qai-reservation-options.xlsx, SLA-exception-request.pdf

Next step: Ben and Karthik — can Sales Ops confirm approval for the one-time onboarding burst and the ramp-trigger language? If so, I'll send a revised mutal action plan to Quantify.

Best,
Naomi

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-27T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Cluster reservation conversation — initial options

Naomi,

We can approve the onboarding burst (one-time, 8 GPUs for 72 hours) for Standard enterprise contracts. Need to lock in a 3-month notice for any downsize to avoid churn gaming. Also suggest adding a staged discount: 7% at 8 GPUs, 12% at 16 GPUs, 17% at 32 GPUs (applied to per-token unit price for reserved capacity).

Karthik — please confirm the 85% utilization trigger and the 14-day validation window are operationally sound.

-Ben
Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Oliver Grant <oliver@quantify.ai>, procurement@quantify.ai
Date: 2026-11-29T16:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Cluster reservation conversation — initial options

Oliver — quick operational note and next steps:

- The 85% rolling utilization trigger + 14-day validation is implementable. We'll use token ingress metrics aggregated by model variant and region. If validation fails, Ops will provide a report and a 7-day remediation window before automatic ramp.
- To support the onboarding burst, we'll pre-warm the KV cache and reserve transient capacity in our US-west pool; expect slightly higher cold-start tail during the 72-hour window but within SLOs.

Action items:
1) Procurement: confirm acceptance of staged discount schedule and 3-month downsize notice.
2) Naomi: send revised mutual action plan & updated quote with attach links to DocuSign.
3) Quantify: share the expected launch week and any compliance/region constraints.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Dedicated Solutions, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
